state:
Goal `core-ratelimit-and-3-more`. `Core\RateLimit`, `Core\RateLimit\Decision` and `Core\Reflect` owe nothing: `bun nv proofs --verify --group` is green for all three, and every perf figure is current against `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/reflect.rs` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ratelimit.rs` as they stand.
`Core\Reflect` and `Core\Reflect\AttributeInfo` both carry a class card now, and neither is in `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` any more.
`Core\Reflect\AttributeInfo` is the last red check (`dossier-core-reflect-attributeinfo`): its five members `name`, `target`, `parameter`, `fields` and `field` each owe two test cases, three examples, an attack and a bench. The card is done.
Any further edit to `reflect.rs` makes the three `Core\Reflect` figures stale again: re-record with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --only '<feature>'` for `Core\Reflect::typeOf`, `::forClass` and `::forObject` as well as for whatever `AttributeInfo` member lands.

next.title: the dossier
next.note: one file set: the `ATTRIBUTE_INFO` members in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/reflect.rs`, its test module, and the proof trees under `core/Reflect-AttributeInfo/`.

items.text: **Tests from both sides for all five `AttributeInfo` members** — one `.nvst` case under `tests/conformance/core/` carrying a `// covers:` line per member, and Rust `#[test]`s in `reflect.rs`'s test module with the same markers: an instance member is credited by a marker only. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/reflect.rs:1482` `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/reflect.rs:2375`

**Examples, an attack and a bench for `name`, `target`, `parameter`, `fields` and `field`** — reached through `Core\Reflect::forClass(...)->attributes()`. `field` throws a `LogicError` for an unknown field and for a value it does not fold, which is what the attack aims at. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/reflect.rs:2323`

**Record the benches** with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --only '<feature>'` once the last Rust edit is in, and re-record the three `Core\Reflect` members if `reflect.rs` moved. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/reflect.rs:1482`

backlog: The other six `Core\Reflect\*Info` classes still sit in `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`); they belong to goal `core-class-cards`, not this one.
